messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning a "Community Starter Kit" (tutorial + ref app + launch post). Goal: get dev adoption + seed repo stars. Target launch: May 18. Thoughts?
jordan: love it. what's the core demo? a tiny Redwood-hosted chat app + embeddings?
maya: yes — 2 quick guides: 1) tutorial (15-20 min) "build a chat with Redwood API", 2) ref app repo with Docker + deploy.yml. Also a short benchmark note for fairness (latency/cost).
sophia: on benchmarks — need eng-ml to run p95 latency and cost/token for 1k req/day and 100k req/day. I can write narrative if you give numbers.
liam: I can run the runs. tag me and give model/seq length/replicas. Suggest: redwood/small-v1 quantized, 512 seq, batch=8.
maya: perfect. @liam please run by EOD Thu. @sophia you'll get numbers Fri morning.
nina: for webinar: recommend 45min — 20min demo, 15min deep dive on perf/cost, 10min Q&A. Speakers: maya + liam + jordan?
jordan: can do demo + write code samples. need slides by May 15.
maya: inbound lead routing — we should tag refapp signups in Intercom with "starter-kit". Then zap to SFDC lead owner if company size >50. Can someone set the Intercom tag + zap?
sophia: I'll add Intercom rule plus a Zapier webhook: payload = { "email", "company_size", "trial_plan", "tag":"starter-kit" }
maya: add FAQ + troubleshooting in README — common errors: CORS, KMS perms, model OOM. Put small troubleshooting block in tutorial.
marketing-bot: Reminder: booking calendar for webinar slot May 18 16:00 UTC — proposal sent to speakers.
liam: PR for benchmark scripts: github.com/redwood-inference/starter-kit/benchmarks — draft pushed. Quick snippet:
```bash
python run_bench.py --model redwood/small-v1 --seq 512 --batch 8 --requests 1000
```
sophia: copy for launch post: "Launch the Redwood Community Starter Kit — 15-minute tutorial + reference app. See how it performs at typical scales and how to optimize cost." I'll iterate.
jordan: social plan: announce on X, Dev.to, and Repo README -> include badges and "Try in Playground" link. Need short tagline variants:
- "Start building LLM features in 15 minutes with Redwood"
- "A reference app for safe, low-latency LLM serving"
maya: prefer #1 but tweak: "Build LLM features in 15 minutes — low-latency, production-ready"
nina: I'll draft the landing + webinar CTAs. Will also create a Post-launch nurture: 3-email drip for signups (welcome, deep dive, case studies).
maya: timeline recap: liam bench by Thu, slides by May 15, landing + Intercom by May 12, rehearsal May 17, launch May 18. Any blockers?
jordan: need final demo creds and staging endpoint. @eng-infra can we get a one-day staging instance with reserved capacity?
maya: good point — I'll ping eng-infra channel after this. :thumbsup:
sophia: I'll prepare the benchmark table + charts and lean copy for post.
nina: noted, will build nurture sequence and tag flows.
maya: thanks everyone — I'll collate tasks in the launch PR. :party:
liam: :rocket:
marketing-bot: Event RSVP count: 0 -> will update.
